rows.ja: クラウド基盤の供給元
提携・連携・資金調達

relations.text: ZMPはパブリッククラウド(AWS/Google/Azure)とプライベートクラウドを組み合わせたZeta Hybrid Cloud上で稼働する
relations.text_en: The ZMP is hosted in the Zeta Hybrid Cloud, pairing a public cloud (AWS/Google/Azure) with a self-hosted private cloud

source.label: Zeta Global 10-K
source.quote: The ZMP is hosted in the Zeta Hybrid Cloud, which is a unique pairing of a public cloud (AWS/Google/Azure) deployment and self-hosted private cloud (VMware/Docker/Kubernetes) resources designed to facilitate workload management in a cost-effective, performant and efficient manner.
source.note: AWS、Azureと並んで挙げられている記載です。

relations.text: ZetaはOpenAIとの提携のもとで、ライセンスを受けたAI技術を利用している
relations.text_en: Zeta uses AI technologies licensed from third parties, including under its partnership with OpenAI

source.label: Zeta Global 10-K
source.quote: In addition to our proprietary AI Technologies, we use AI Technologies licensed from third parties in our technologies, including under our partnership with OpenAI, and our ability to continue to use such technologies at the scale we need may be dependent on access to specific third-party software and infrastructure.

relations.text: Zeta Marketing PlatformとSalesforce CRMの連携で、顧客データをSalesforce CRMへ作成・同期できる
relations.text_en: The Salesforce CRM integration allows customers to be created and syndicated from the Zeta Marketing Platform to Salesforce CRM

source.label: Zeta product documentation · Salesforce CRM integration
source.label_en: Zeta product documentation · Salesforce CRM integration
source.quote: This channel manager integration with Salesforce CRM allows for the creation and syndication of customers from the Zeta Marketing Platform to Salesforce CRM.

companies.name: バンク・オブ・アメリカ

relations.text: 2024年8月30日付のBank of America, N.A.との借入契約で、2億ドルが残っている
relations.text_en: $200.0 million is outstanding under the loan and security agreement with Bank of America, N.A. dated August 30, 2024

source.label: Zeta Global 10-K
source.quote: As of the date hereof, we have $200.0 million outstanding under our loan and security agreement (“Senior Secured Credit Facility”) with Bank of America, N.A., dated August 30, 2024.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: Bank of AmericaとBofA Securitiesが貸し手側に名を連ねるクレジット契約がある
relations.text_en: A credit agreement lists Bank of America and BofA Securities, Inc. among the parties

source.label: Zeta Global 10-K
source.quote: Credit Agreement among Zeta Global Corp., Zeta Global Holdings Corp., Certain Subsidiaries, the lenders party thereto, Bank of America, and BofA Securities, Inc.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
